summary: Added fees $50-58 (they were only in the note), facilities, year-round, Firefly booking. Hookups confirmed. Note cleaned of rates and RV Life/Google lines.
flags: PRICE GATE at the line: $50 posted for water + 30-amp, not over US$50. No gateway (Detroit 112 km). Good Sam Park (directory gs true, matches stored good_sam true): member price $45. Google Maps: Bluegrass Campground, 4.6 from 271 reviews, (419) 875-5110, bluegrasscampground.com. Firefly's search was not run (reCAPTCHA, standing rule), so the $50 isn't checked against a dated quote or a motorhome type.

LONG-STAY / WORKFORCE: the site carries a page 'Extended-Stay RV Sites for Traveling Workers' (monthly $625-655 + electric; background screening past 30 days; 'Package receiving ... long-term and seasonal'). Nightly rates are posted (test 2 passes), but no site count or nightly share is on the pages read, so test 4 isn't evidenced. 'RV sites for short-term and seasonal stays' reads as mixed use; worth AWH's eye against the workforce-park exclusion.

WATERFRONT: operator's 'Swimming & Fishing Pond' has a sandy beach; stored 'not waterfront' says rows sit round a small pond, not at the water's edge. Weak lead only, since the note also says 'sites around a pond'.
Rig length and pull-through aren't stated on the pages read, left unset. flush toilets implied by 'restrooms' only, left unset.
note: Family campground near Swanton, close to Oak Openings Metropark and the Ohio Turnpike (exit 52); sites around a pond. --Claude
